prompt: Review my pipeline and list any deals that have been in the same stage for more than 21 days without a next step.
expected: The agent should load references/pipeline.md, identify stalled deals using stall_days/next-step rules, and recommend closing lost or setting a dated next step.
actual: Agent loaded references/pipeline.md and references/metrics.md, listed stalled deals older than 21 days without a future next step, and recommended move-to-closed-lost or next-step updates.

prompt: I have a CSV of 500 leads to import. How should I approach this to avoid messing up my CRM?
expected: The agent should load references/import.md, require an export/backup first, map fields, dedupe on email, and run a dry run before importing only leads to contact this quarter.
actual: Agent loaded references/import.md and advised: export backup first, map fields with email as identity key, dry-run a small sample, then import only leads that will be contacted this quarter.
